definitions.route_exclusive_chemical_system: Element set present in exactly one route's candidate records within this screened dataset; not a claim of database novelty or physical stability.
definitions.relaxed_2d: is_relaxed == True and dim_type == 2D in the unpassivated post-ML dimensionality table; not DFT stability.
definitions.route_assignment: Single provenance flag assigned to each post-deduplication candidate record.
definitions.archived_initial_slab_layergroup: spglib layer-group label on archived post-deduplication CIFs; longest lattice vector chosen as aperiodic direction and symprec 1e-5. These labels are symmetry descriptors, not distinct prototypes or validated phases.
